mods.title: Mods
mods.empty:
No mods installed.

A mod goes in its own folder, Stoneshard\mods\<mod>\: its C# source, and its pictures in Assets\.
mods.author: Author: {0}
mods.required_by_one: Required by {0} - switching this off switches it off too.
mods.required_by_many: Required by {0} - switching this off switches them off too.
mods.enabled_next_start: Enabled for the next start. Not applied to this run.
mods.restart_required: Changes to Enabled take effect after restarting.
mods.enabled_tooltip: Switched on or off straight away. Switched off, its items are taken out of the game - load a save from before to get them back once it's on again.
mods.sml_tooltip: Applied on the next start; cannot be hot-reloaded.
mods.trusted_warning: This mod asks for full access: it runs outside StoneForge's security, with its own DLLs, and can do anything a program on your PC can - files, the network, other programs. Only allow mods you trust. Ticking Enabled allows it.
mods.gml_warning: This mod uses GML bindings and can bypass StoneForge's security. Its GML can't be hot-reloaded: changes need a restart of the game. Use at your own discretion.
mods.sml_warning: This MSL mod runs unrestricted C# while patching and can access files, the network and other programs. Its game changes require a restart. MSL mods in the mods folder are enabled: only put ones you trust there.

dialogue_editor.title: Dialogue Editor
dialogue_editor.empty: No StoneForge mod dialogues are registered.
dialogue_editor.text_hint: Text (use \n for a new line). Apply to preview; Save to keep edits.
dialogue_editor.topic_slot: Topic position: 1 = first option. Blank = the mod's default. Large values place it last.
dialogue_editor.response_slot: Response position: 1 = first response in this node.
dialogue_editor.behavior_hint: Text edits override dynamic and translated text for this language. Conditions, destinations and quest actions are preserved. Selecting a node here does not enter it.
dialogue_editor.ready: Choose a line, response or Talk topic to edit.
dialogue_editor.draft: Draft changed. Apply or Save before changing selections.
dialogue_editor.reset_hint: Default restored. Save to keep the reset. Resetting a response also restores this node's response order.
dialogue_editor.talk_hint: Open the NPC's Talk conversation to view your edits in game.
dialogue_editor.unloaded: This dialogue's mod has been unloaded.
dialogue_editor.invalid_text: Text must be at most 8192 characters. Topics and responses cannot be empty.
dialogue_editor.invalid_slot: Enter a valid option number (topics: 1-128; responses: 1 to the node's response count).
dialogue_editor.applied_topic: Applied for this session. Reopen Talk to see the topic text and position. Save to keep edits.
dialogue_editor.applied: Applied for this session; the open conversation refreshes. Save to keep edits.
dialogue_editor.topic_hint: Open Talk once to capture the current topic label, or type a replacement.
npc_editor.title: Edit this NPC's dialogue
npc_editor.hint: Right-click NPC text or a response for Edit text and Move up/down. Text edits affect only this displayed variant; other NPC states keep their own text. Done resumes conversation.
npc_editor.draft: Apply, save or reset this draft before selecting another entry.
npc_editor.inline_hint: Edit in place. Enter saves; Escape cancels.
mods.dev_hint: Develop dialogue for this mod. Only one mod can have dev mode enabled. NPC edits save to this mod's Dialogue folder in a file per NPC and load with the mod.
npc_editor.condition_hint: Choose a condition function for this response.
npc_editor.condition_empty: No conditions registered. Add [DialogCondition("key")] to a static DialogConditionResult method, then reload the mod.
npc_editor.code_hint: Choose a StoneForge trigger or mod function for this response.
npc_editor.code_empty: No functions registered. Add [DialogOption("key")] to a static void method in this mod, then reload it.
npc_editor.applied: Updated in the NPC's dialogue window. Save to keep changes.
npc_editor.saved: Saved. NPC edits load again on the next game start.
npc_editor.invalid_position: Enter an option number from 1 to 128.
npc_editor.reset_line: Original text will return when the NPC displays this line again.
npc_editor.no_default: This authored topic has no vanilla default. Edit its reply here, or delete the topic from the NPC menu.

report.invalid: Choose a repository and fill in the title and description.
report.title: Report a bug
report.subject: Title (5–120 characters)
report.uncertain: Could not confirm submission. It may have arrived; check GitHub before sending again. Your draft is kept.
report.unavailable: This mod is no longer enabled or its repository changed. Reopen this window.
report.failed: BugDrop could not accept the report. Check the repository setup; your draft is kept.
report.limit_storage: Could not save report limits. Check access to the dotnet folder.
report.help: Describe what happened, what you expected, and how to reproduce it.
report.server_limit: BugDrop is limiting requests. Please try later.
report.limit_clock: The clock changed. Please correct the system time before reporting.
report.rate_limit: Report limit reached (3 per hour, 10 per day). Please try later.
report.duplicate: This report was already attempted in the last 24 hours.
report.notice: Sends your report and system details to BugDrop and GitHub. No screenshots or attachments.
report.payload_large: The report is too large. Shorten it or turn off console logs.
report.app_not_installed: Install the BugDrop GitHub App on the selected repository.
report.auth_required: BugDrop requires authentication for this repository.
report.repo_not_allowed: BugDrop does not allow reports for this repository.
